parameters.name: Terrain Morphology
parameters.value: Heavily cratered Noachian upland with eroded layered deposits. Meridiani is a flat plain; flatness and thin cover suggest the original sedimentary surface
parameters.sourceTitle: Squyres et al. 2004, Science - Soils of Eagle Crater and Meridiani Planum

parameters.name: Surface Material / Regolith
parameters.value: Fine-grained basaltic sands mixed with dust and sulfate-rich debris; hematite spherules concentrated at surface; soil thickness ≈ 1 m. Bulk density not retrieved
parameters.sourceTitle: Squyres et al. 2004, Science - Soils of Eagle Crater and Meridiani Planum

parameters.name: Chemical Composition
parameters.value: Outcrop is 20–40% Ca/Mg sulfate (Mini-TES). Hematite up to ≈ 20% in patches (TES abundances 5–20% from orbit). Oxia Planum: Fe,Mg-rich clays (saponite-type) with carbonates
parameters.sourceTitle: Earlier research source (see URL)

parameters.value: Dust devils observed by Spirit and Opportunity; winds weak outside dust storms
parameters.sourceTitle: Squyres et al. 2006, JGR - Spirit overview (Gusev, Columbia Hills)

parameters.name: Biological Characteristics
